scope: Isolated AOS plus Lab coexistence acceptance driver and caller-supplied desktop manifest pin.

execution.preflight_pending_reason: Root has not yet supplied the frozen 0.25 private Lab worktree and finalized suite registry paths.

features: Explicit --execute switch; default only verifies the trusted suite registry and prints a no-GPU preflight result.
Actual path uses AOS typed Lab start, canonical run-bound Lab dispatcher unit, foreground hello task, status/report APIs, and private Lab report CLI.
Requires both owners to have completed GPU turns, sampled overlap of real work and owner units, and asserts the detached Lab job never appears in the AOS foreground scheduler jobs.
Separate restart-recovery phase quiesces, restarts the exact AOS unit, verifies a new session, explicitly recovers the same Lab run, and checks its terminal report.
Records API latency, host memory/NVIDIA samples, bounded systemd unit properties, GPU-turn ledger, input manifest hashes, and only error type on failure; no prompt/model reasoning is collected.
Only accepts an isolated Lab worktree under project data/runtime, loopback Lab API, private DSN/token files, exact AOS owner unit namespace, and bounded experiment/wall/token/poll values.

desktop_manifest_patch.change: Adds --desktop-manifest, retaining the existing default, and passes the explicit path into DesktopRuntime.

checks.reason: Host system Python lacks uvicorn; the isolated AOS virtualenv check above passed. No package installation was attempted.

checks.command: git -C <isolated-AOS> worktree add --detach <temporary-clean-worktree> HEAD; git -C <temporary-clean-worktree> apply --check aos-lab-desktop-manifest.patch; remove temporary worktree

limitations: This is a prepared acceptance driver, not an AOS/Lab coexistence result.
The 27-task public suite remains a runtime-supplied registered manifest identified by hash; this driver does not substitute fixtures or claim public-suite evidence.
The AOS package gate and actual model/GPU acceptance remain root-owned and unrun here.
